resources.string: The message goes to the Telegram server at once as a scheduled message, and the server publishes it after the chosen time. The app may be closed by then.
While the message waits, you can cancel it, move it or send it now from the chat\'s scheduled messages. For files the time grows to leave room for the upload.

This lowers the chance of showing you online but does not guarantee it: the app does not control your other devices or Telegram\'s rules. Secret chats, chats with paid messages, view-once media and live location cannot be scheduled, and the app asks whether to send at once.
Scheduled on the Telegram server. The message appears in the chat at the set time.
Could not schedule the message on the Telegram server.
Telegram does not support scheduled messages in secret chats.
Telegram does not support scheduled messages in chats with paid messages.
Telegram does not support scheduled messages in this chat.
View-once media and live location cannot be scheduled.
The message was not sent. If you send it now, Telegram may show you online for about 30 seconds.
